tasks.short: Instruct and monitor safe equipment and material use

steps.what: Find the current instructions for the actual classroom equipment or material
Inspect actual equipment, materials and pupil readiness for safe use
Instruct pupils in safe use and care to prevent injury and damage
Monitor actual equipment use and intervene to prevent injuries or damage

tasks.design: Configure direct equipment-to-instruction links in {DOCS} before any custom assistant. Remove only repeat folder navigation, retaining instruction reading, physical checks, pupil instruction and continuous monitoring.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small reference-navigation step precedes predominantly physical safety work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links can open the maintained instructions for a known equipment ID.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe pupil behaviour and equipment condition in real time.
tasks.human_edge: Intervene immediately and explain safe practice to the actual pupils.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less instruction navigation with unchanged safety duties.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document links can reuse known equipment-to-instruction references; inspecting and supervising equipment use remain physical human duties.

assumptions: Provisional workflow has an actual instruction lookup, not an invented safety report. The classroom teacher or equipment owner maintains equipment ID, instruction version and link; reading and source checking remain the assistant's counted work.
Native links are tested first. Only 1 of 5 repeated folder-navigation points is removed; 4 remain reading, selection and broken-link fallback. Existing direct links have no labour-saving baseline.

Physical inspection, instruction and monitoring retain all their time. No new injury log or equipment-use record is imposed; any actual incident report must be separately assessed when an incident occurs.
unknowns: Existing direct links and actual navigation effort
research_questions: Observe equipment preparation and distinguish instruction navigation from reading and physical checks.

incremental.description: Check changed instruction links and equipment references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 1 navigation point less 0.3 upkeep. New equipment needs fresh source reading and has only 0.4 points of reusable reference navigation: 0.4 minus 0.3 = 0.1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss assigned duties with classroom teachers

steps.what: Read the teacher's actual assigned duties and lesson context
Discuss assigned duties with classroom teachers to coordinate instructional efforts

tasks.design: Retain actual assignment reading in {DOCS} or {LMS} and discussion with the classroom teacher. Native shared access already supplies the duty information here; the discussion resolves instructional responsibilities rather than producing a new administrative record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination requires understanding the teacher's intentions and clarifying live questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native shared plans provide context but do not replace the coordination conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Clarifying who will do what for the actual lesson and pupils.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise ambiguity and agree workable responsibilities with the teacher.
tasks.altitude: No change to instructional coordination or teacher authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: teaching-assistant coordination depends on reading actual assignments and clarifying responsibilities with the teacher; it does not inherently require a separate duty-discussion log.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is duty reading and discussion. The classroom teacher produces assignments as part of their existing planning work, not new free assistant preparation; the assistant's reading remains counted.

Before zero, inspect plan lookup, preparation, shared-schedule updates and follow-up messages. Native access is already direct and no separate written output is established for this discussion. Any actual required schedule edit or send must be added and assessed before estimating that broader workflow.
No new coordination minutes, transcript or duty log is introduced. No repeated navigation baseline is invented; no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual shared-schedule or written follow-up duty
research_questions: Observe teacher-assistant coordination and identify real preparation, record edits or sends.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 20 assignment-reading and 80 discussion points. A new lesson needs full clarification of duties; no established duplicate entry, written report or send is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present subject matter under teacher guidance

steps.what: Read the teacher's lesson guidance and prepare the assigned presentation material
Present subject matter through lecture, discussion, supervised role-play or reading aloud

tasks.design: Keep the assistant's preparation from actual teacher guidance in {DOCS} and {LMS} and their live subject presentation. Native access already provides the assigned material; no new content-generation operation is established within this presentation task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant must understand and personally deliver the teacher-directed subject matter.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared materials provide access but do not replace understanding or pupil interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Presenting clearly while following teacher guidance and responding to the actual pupils.
tasks.human_edge: Notice confusion and adjust delivery within the teacher's instructions.
tasks.altitude: No change to teacher-directed instructional responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live subject presentation under teacher guidance requires personal preparation and classroom interaction; a new material-authoring duty is not implied by presenting assigned material.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is preparing to present assigned existing material and then delivering it. Teacher-owned design remains the teacher's existing work and is not credited to the assistant. Actual assistant material creation would require its own counted step if assigned.

Before zero, inspect material lookup, preparation, handout creation, presentation-file editing and required records. Native access is already direct and this scenario establishes no separate written output. Add any real authoring or send before estimating a broader workflow.
No new classroom-progress log, transcript or pupil score is introduced. Full preparation and live delivery remain; no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual assistant-owned material editing or preparation output
research_questions: Observe an assigned presentation and distinguish actual reading from any real file or handout creation.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 20 preparation and 80 presentation points. An unfamiliar subject needs full preparation and pupil interaction; no actual repeated record operation or required material-authoring output is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe performance and record progress data

steps.what: Observe actual pupil performance and capture the teacher-specified relevant progress data
Enter the relevant observed data into the existing pupil-progress record
Check observations, pupil identity and completeness and retain the ordinary progress record
outputs: checked progress data for the teacher

tasks.design: Configure the existing pupil-observation form in {LMS} to reuse roster and activity identifiers. Retain direct observation, actual data entry, complete identity and meaning checks and ordinary saving; the teacher remains responsible for educational interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Original observation entry repeats identifiers alongside fresh performance evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form defaults can reuse roster and activity fields without assessing pupils.
tasks.still_hard: Capturing relevant observations accurately without inferring more than was seen.
tasks.human_edge: Notice context and distinguish observed behaviour from interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less repeated identifier entry with unchanged observation duty.

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes ParnasSys as a pupil records system; this supports the record-application pattern, not a measured saving for this task.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for actual teacher-required observation data used to assess progress, not a newly invented class log. The teacher supplies criteria and existing roster/activity context; the assistant's live observation and capture remain fully counted.

The assistant verifies pupil ID, date, activity, criterion and actual observed response in s1-s2. Native defaults are tested first. Only 2 of 25 repeated roster/activity-entry points are removed; 23 retain new observations, input checks, missing roster correction and ordinary save.
Existing automatic field population earns no labour credit. s3 retains full identity, completeness and observation checks. More mapping repair than retained requires a lower estimate.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained and ungated. No model scores pupils, infers emotions or sends results; a separate actual release would need its own counted gate.
unknowns: Actual observation form and repeated identifier effort
research_questions: Observe record entry and compare native defaults while counting new data capture and all corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain roster/activity defaults and inspect changed observation forms

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 2 repeated identifier points less 0.5 upkeep. New pupils or activities require fresh setup; reuse only 0.8 points of stable roster fields while retaining other entry: 0.8 minus 0.5 = 0.3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain classroom instruction, coordination, safety and observation while reducing specific reference navigation and repeated progress-record identifiers.
role.ambitious_version: No independent teacher authority, automated pupil assessment or new record duty is proposed.
